ITEM 5  NEW BUSINESS

  Pacific Coast Highway Art Memorial
  Recommended Action: 1) Review the proposed Pacific Coast Highway art
  memorial project; and 2) Provide a recommendation regarding the proposed
  project.

  Caroline Jones stated that she founded DigitalandstoneTM and discussed her
  proposal of creating a memorial art piece. She stated she planned to discuss the
  project with Pepperdine University and wanted support from the City. She stated
  she would seek project funding through private fundraising efforts, the City, and
  Pepperdine University.

  In response to Commissioner Cherin, Ms. Jones stated that DigitalandstoneTM was
  not a nonprofit organization.

  Vice Chair Holland stated the memorial was a great idea.

  Chair Lawrence stated the project would be multilayered, with several
  opportunities to gain support and raise funds from the community and businesses.
  He stated the proposed location on Webb Way and Pacific Coast Highway could
  be supported but suggested reviewing different locations in Malibu or Legacy Park.

  Commissioner Jones stated there had been issues installing sculptures in the City
  and suggested that the artist learn what was allowed. He suggested incorporating
  water into the memorial sculpture.

  Commissioner Cherin suggested the artist attend and present her proposal to the
  Parks and Recreation and Public Safety Commissions.

  Chair Lawrence indicated agreement with Commissioner Cherin.

  Community Services Director Riesgo stated the Planning Department would
  provide information on zoning and restrictions regarding the installation of a
  sculpture.

MOTION  Chair Lawrence moved, and Commissioner Cherin seconded a motion to support
  the project concept. The question was called, and the motion carried 4-0;
  Commissioner Haldeman absent.

Subject:  Malibu Citv Gallerv Art Exhibition Schedule

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Review and approve the Malibu Public Art Exhibitions Ad
Hoc Committee recommendation regarding the Fiscal Year 2024-25 Malibu City Gallery
art exhibitions.

DISCUSSION: The Malibu Public Art Exhibitions Ad Hoc Committee (Ad Hoc Committee),
consisting of Chair Lawrence and Vice Chair Holland, prepared a Iist of six art exhibitions
for the 2024-25 Malibu City Gallery Exhibition Schedule. The proposed list of exhibitions
includes:

  Derek Shimming Retrospective Show and the Malibu Arts Association; All Mediums
  Still Life Holiday Show; All Mediums
  Student Art Exhibition; All Mediums
  Sue Wong; Fashion Design
  Kathy and Dan Eldon; Art of Journaling
  Surf Culture Multi-Artist Exhibition; All Mediums

Derek Shimminq Retrospective Show and Malibu Arts Association
Derek Shimming was the President of the Malibu Arts Association (Association) and a
notable local artist. He partnered with the Commission to showcase Malibu Arts
Association artists at the Malibu City Gallery Opening Receptions and showcased his work
in various multi-artist exhibitions. In the Spring of 2024, Mr. Shimming unexpectedly
passed away, and the community suffered a great loss and advocated for local public art.
Partnering with the Association, the Ad Hoc recommends coordinating a retrospective
show with Mr. Shimming’s artwork and showcasing three to four Association artists.

  Page 1 of2
  Agenda Item # 5.A.
 Still Life Holiday Show
Focusing on the art of still life, the Commission will partner with the Frederick R. Weisman
Museum of Art at Pepperdine University to feature four to five artists whose work appeals
to the community.

Student Art Exhibition
The City hosts the annual Malibu Student Art Exhibition in February. The Community
Services Department coordinates the Student Art Exhibition in partnership with the Harry
Barovsky Memorial Youth Commission. The exhibition typically has over two hundred
pieces of student artwork from students representing all Malibu public and private schools.

Sue Wong
Fashion designer Sue Wong is best known for her old Hollywood glamor dress designs,
which have been worn by celebrities including Taylor Swift, Miley Cyrus, Ann Hathaway,
Tyra Banks, Jessica Biel, and others. Her collections are available in twenty-seven
countries and have been celebrated as pieces of style representing glamor, femininity,
and romantic vintage sensibilities.

Kathy and Dan Eldon
An interactive art ofjournaling exhibition featuring the work of Kathy and Dan Eldon. Dan
Eldon’s work was featured at the Malibu City Gallery in 2018 and received several
accolades. The Art of Journaling will include photographs and works in journalism. Dan
Eldon was a photojournalist, artist, and avid adventurer. In 1993, he lost his life covering
the tragic conflict in Mogadishu. His mother, Kathy Eldon, founded the non-profit
organization Creative Visions and carries on her son’s legacy of creative activism.

Surf Culture
Since 2022, the Commission has curated a summer exhibition related to Malibu surf
culture, following the popularity of The Art of the Board in 2016. The exhibitions have
featured several local and regional artists. Due to Malibu’s influential surf culture and
history, the Commission recommended that future exhibition schedules include at least
one surf—related exhibition each year.

The exhibitions will be open to the public from 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM, Monday through
Friday, at the Malibu City Gallery in City Hall. Funding for the exhibitions, including
marketing, online art call submission fees, and supplies, were included in the Adopted
Budget for Fiscal Year 2024-25. The Ad Hoc Committee will curate and coordinate the
programs related to each exhibition and provide updates during Commission Regular
meetings.

ATTACHMENTS: None.
